interstitial.why: AdService has interstitial code (lib/monetization/ad_service.dart:117-170), but nothing in lib/ calls showInterstitial or shouldShowInterstitial. monetization_config.dart:166-168 says 'interstitial/native have no call sites'. The app is a quick calculator/notepad utility, so do not add one. The unused code can be deleted.

native.why: The only list is the Sheets list (sheets_list_screen.dart:150-153 ListView.separated -> _SheetTile): a short index of the user's own working documents (expenses, invoices, loans). It is not a content feed, it already carries the banner (:40), and it is finance-adjacent data. Convert lists (convert_detail.dart:445-618) are unit pickers, not content. No good native slot.

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. The Pro paywall and in_app_purchase were removed in a4c0e19 ('sign-in and paywall removed'), and the paid features are now free. pubspec.yaml has no purchases_flutter or in_app_purchase, and lib/ has no RevenueCat or premium code. The brief's 'CalcMaster already has RevenueCat' is out of date for the current code. Any rewarded unlock would mean inventing a new limit on a feature that is free today.

blockers: The brief's assumption is stale: RevenueCat/IAP is gone from CalcMaster (git log -S purchases_flutter -- pubspec.yaml -> a4c0e19). If the founder later re-adds Pro (spec CalcMaster.md:379, Q2), reassess rewarded against 3.1.1 then.

CalcMaster does not call AglAds.configure/initialize. It runs its own AdService (lib/main.dart:49) and imports agl_ads only for AglConsent, so AglNativeAd/AglAds.showRewarded would not work without that wiring. Not needed while native and rewarded are 'no'.
